title: Update, 3:26: yes, minions are doing the work

text:
Four cards just arrived above this one; I had written them and not sent them yet. Sorry for the gap.
Yes, everything is with minions now, six of them: the popup system and New version button, backgrounds, Whisper autostart, the dev bar chat tab, the reload hold, and the critic sweep.
Your dev bar path bar went to the minion that already holds the dev bar files: a slim bar in place of the word DEV, a home icon, then the path in the code font on one solid background, slashes between the parts, each part clickable with its own hover highlight, and the route section gone from the page tab.
From here I post a short update at least every ten minutes while anything is in flight.
